title: Provision floor cannot be restored from persisted rollback state on reboot
description: Post-fix correctness review: ProvisionVerifier persists version/epoch/digest, but a new verifier with that state has no current record, so EpochFloorAuthority reports MISSING/build floor until admin re-submits. Define cold-boot restoration that authenticates/binds the persisted canonical record to expected identity/digest and immediately restores the provision floor, or a normative atomic reinstall path; corrupt/mismatch fail closed. Test reboot.
